svg.text: NORTH WALL - RISER ON CONTAINER - BEARING - RAFTERS LAND FULL WIDTH ON RAKED CAP PLATE, NO NOTCH
SOUTH WALL - 6x10 BEAM ON POSTS - BEARING - BIRDSMOUTH SEAT 6", HEEL 2 1/4"
9'-7 1/4" UP THE RAKE FROM THE SOUTH
BARE RAFTER ZONE - METAL DIRECT ON RAFTERS - STRIPS AT PHASE 2
NAILED TO THE EAST FACE OF THE EAST RAFTER,
SPANNING THE EAST WALL THICKNESS ONLY,
FLUSH TO THE WALL OUTER FACE. NAILERS ONLY -
NOT STRUCTURAL. NO CAP BOARD AT THIS EDGE.
PLAN VIEW - LOOKING DOWN - NORTH AT TOP, WEST AT LEFT
1. RAFTER FRAMING ONLY. PANEL LAYOUT ON D-3.
2. ROOF PLANE 7'-8 1/4" AT SOUTH WALL, PEAK 14'-7".
4. RAFTER LAYOUT PULLED FROM WEST WALL.
5. NORTH RISER STUDS REMAIN 16" O.C. - SEE S-4.
6. RAFTERS NO LONGER STACK ON RISER STUDS.
7. EAST WALL CARRIES NO ROOF LOAD.
8. ALL WALLS INSET - FACES ON THE 40'-0" LINE.
9. DESIGN BASIS: 50 PSF GROUND SNOW, REDUCED TO
~24 PSF ON THE ROOF FOR SLOPE AND A SLIPPERY,
HEATED, EXPOSED SURFACE. DERIVATION AND THE
ASSUMPTIONS BEHIND IT ARE IN THE DESIGN SHEET.
2. PLUMB CUT BOTH ENDS, CUTS PARALLEL.
3. NORTH END: FULL BEARING ON RAKED CAP PLATE.
5. MODULAR RUN STOPS 2'-0" SHORT OF EAST WALL.
6. EAST RAFTER SET INBOARD OF EAST WALL INNER FACE.
OFF EAST FACE OF EAST RAFTER ONLY.
9. BLOCKING IS SHEATHING NAILER - NOT STRUCTURAL.
10. NO CAP BOARD AT EAST EDGE - NAILS DIRECT.
